Anthropic detected and disrupted the campaign.

(((Tendar))) (@Tendar)

Government forces are pulling back to Dhubab, directly on Bab el Mandeb, opposite Perim island. Whoever holds that stretch of coast holds the strait. Why this is the most important oil headline of the week, ahead of tankers off Kharg. Hormuz is effectively shut. Every barrel Saudi Arabia has kept flowing since spring has gone west to Yanbu and out through the Red Sea. Bab el Mandeb is the exit for that route, and the Houthis have declared a naval blockade on Riyadh since July. Mocha puts their forces within reach of both shores. The market has priced Hormuz for 7 months. It has not priced losing the Red Sea too. If the Houthis take Dhubab and Perim, Saudi crude has no sea route east or west that is not under fire, Suez traffic that recovered 42% in July goes into reverse and the Sumed pipeline into the Mediterranean becomes the only clean path out of the Gulf. That is not a $100 world. It is the scenario that takes real Brent toward the 1980 and 2008 peaks. 2 more things from the same story. Tehran told Pakistan's envoys that "Iran does not control the Houthis," which means nobody on the phone can call this off and the Wall Street Journal reports Vance and Rubio have privately warned Trump the war could run through January 2029. Brent held above $100 on all of it. The strait to watch has changed.

items.title: Jared Kushner‘s Win-Win statement is exposing the absolute lack of understanding of the situation or worse. Putin is not thinking in „business terms“. He has accumulated wealth which he won’t be able to spend in 100 lifetimes, by some accounts making him even the richest person on earth. Putin is passed that. For him it is now only about legacy. He wants that people in the next centuries look back and call his name next to Peter the Great and Stalin. He will not achieve that by calling his invasion off. In the contrary, calling it off would only make him hang naked upside down the Kremlin wall, because he has achieved nothing other than diminishing Russia. Kushner‘s apparent ignorance not only shows why every peace offers fail, it also explains why it only fuels the war. Putin thinks for good reasons that he is dealing with absolute amateurs in the White House, who can get played with „business talk“, giving him only more time. Just look the last two years and you see that Russia hasn’t moved an inch, and under Putin never ever will. Any half-intelligent person would question the cause of actions and alter the direction. But those in the White House can help themselves. This whole stunt was predictably a waste of time.

items.title: RT by @ChrisO_wiki: Stunned but not surprised to see people ignoring AfD's close ties to China in their coverage of the far-right German party's historic victory this weekend. AfD accused Germany of launching "economic war" against China, and is critical of restrictions against Huawei. AfD's co-chair Alice Weidel spent six years in China, speaks excellent Mandarin, and speaks almost exclusively positively about China. A senior aide to an AfD politician was convicted of spying for Chinese intelligence, after passing hundreds of European Parliament documents to Beijing. This is crucial information about AfD and it belongs in every story about the party.

items.title: RT by @COUPSURE: Driving through rural Switzerland. Cows, church steeples, the whole postcard. Then a billboard: "No to war. Yes to neutrality." For a second I wasn't in Switzerland. I was in Georgia. Same slogan. In Georgia "No to war" is on the lips of every pro-Russian politician and every government official, while the war Russia started sits 40 km from the capital. Same simulated war-news videos, same "they want to drag us into war," same voice telling you the only danger is your own government. Let me spell it out: nobody is dragging Switzerland into a war. No one is invading Switzerland. No one asked Switzerland to send troops. The only "war" this billboard is against is the sanctions on the guy who actually started one. That's the trick. It's not a neutrality campaign. It's a Kremlin script with a Swiss cross on it: "war" means "helping the victim," "neutrality" means "helping the aggressor," and "peace" means "shut up and buy Russian gas." I watched this exact script eat Georgia. Now I see it in Germany, France, Switzerland. The KGB doesn't need tanks to win in the free world. It needs a billboard and a voter who thinks the aggressor is somewhere else. Russia is not coming to Switzerland. Russia is already here. It's on the roadside.
